result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full offline test suite passes, but I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `PurchaseOrderStore.countPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/PurchaseOrderStore.java`). The count query now adds the existing `NOT_CANCELLED` condition, the same one the quarterly and latest-purchase-order queries use. I also added a line to the method's Javadoc saying cancelled orders are left out.

I didn't touch the shared period clause (`FOR_WAREHOUSE_REGION_IN_PERIOD`), because another query uses it. Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
